related.title: IBM 超導雙量子門：條件旋轉與時長預算
related.titleEn: IBM superconducting two-qubit gates: conditional rotation and duration
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付殘差拋物線、I/Q時序圖與相位檢查清單。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver a residual parabola, I/Q timing diagram and phase checks. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM 超導雙量子門：條件旋轉與時長預算』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付有效項表、角度反算與完整門時間帳。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM superconducting two-qubit gates: conditional rotation and duration', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver effective-interaction terms, inverse-angle calculation and complete gate-time accounting.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：本題用原創代理L=(εΩ/Δ)²，ε是校正後導數通道殘差比例；它只適合比較殘差，不是完整DRAG推導。 使用教學Ω/2π=20 MHz、Δ/2π=200 MHz、ε=0.2。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(0.2*20/200)**2，另開一欄執行獨立核對：掃描ε=−0.2、0、0.2，確認平方模型對稱；若合成資料不對稱，增加相位或失諧項而不硬套拋物線。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學有效Hamiltonian H/ℏ=(Ω_ZX/2)ZX，條件旋轉角θ=Ω_ZX t；省略其他交互作用，需另行校準。 使用假設Ω_ZX/(2π)=1 MHz，目標θ=π/2；t以μs計。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(pi/2)/(2*pi*1e6)*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：把新時長代回Ωt，兩組均得π/2；再列每段echo或單量子補償的額外時間。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Use original proxy L=(εΩ/Δ)² with residual quadrature factor ε; it compares residuals, not a complete DRAG derivation. Use Teaching Ω/2π=20 MHz, Δ/2π=200 MHz and ε=0.2. Evaluate nominal expression (0.2*20/200)**2 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Sweep ε=−0.2,0,0.2 to test symmetry; asymmetric data require phase or detuning terms, not a forced parabola.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Teaching effective Hamiltonian H/ℏ=(Ω_ZX/2)ZX gives θ=Ω_ZX t; other interactions are omitted and need separate calibration. Use Assume Ω_ZX/(2π)=1 MHz and target θ=π/2; express t in μs. Evaluate nominal expression (pi/2)/(2*pi*1e6)*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Substitute new duration into Ωt to recoverπ/2 in both cases; separately list echo and single-qubit compensation time.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Multiplexed superconducting readout: frequency slots and guard bands

related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：本題用原創代理L=(εΩ/Δ)²，ε是校正後導數通道殘差比例；它只適合比較殘差，不是完整DRAG推導。 使用教學Ω/2π=20 MHz、Δ/2π=200 MHz、ε=0.2。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(0.2*20/200)**2，另開一欄執行獨立核對：掃描ε=−0.2、0、0.2，確認平方模型對稱；若合成資料不對稱，增加相位或失諧項而不硬套拋物線。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：N個頻槽各寬w，相鄰保護g，總佔寬B=Nw+(N−1)g；端點保護另列，不可重複計算。 使用合成N=8、每槽w=12 MHz、相鄰g=8 MHz；可用帶寬180 MHz。 以手算或試算表計算名義式8*12+7*8，另開一欄執行獨立核對：畫出槽邊界而非只列中心頻率；檢查最右減最左恰好等於佔寬。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Use original proxy L=(εΩ/Δ)² with residual quadrature factor ε; it compares residuals, not a complete DRAG derivation. Use Teaching Ω/2π=20 MHz, Δ/2π=200 MHz and ε=0.2. Evaluate nominal expression (0.2*20/200)**2 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Sweep ε=−0.2,0,0.2 to test symmetry; asymmetric data require phase or detuning terms, not a forced parabola.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: N slots of width w separated by guard g occupy B=Nw+(N−1)g; list edge guards separately. Use Synthetic N=8, per-slot w=12 MHz and inter-slot g=8 MHz; available band is180 MHz. Evaluate nominal expression 8*12+7*8 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Draw slot boundaries rather than only centers; rightmost minus leftmost edge must equal occupied bandwidth.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
